# Shuttle Brief
The Rivet is a compact engineering and recovery shuttle designed to provide essential repair, fabrication, and field support capabilities at a lowered entry cost.
Its small hull and practical layout make it well suited for independent engineering work, emergency repairs, and recovery operations where a larger engineering vessel is unnecessary.
[italic]Brought to you by Stonian Industries.[/italic]

# Operational Notes
Standard recommendations:
1. Take note of standard Piloting guides.
2. Take note of relevant standard role guides.
3. Ensure all critical components are anchored.
4. Take note of base power load and adjust generators accordingly to reduce fuel consumption.
5. Follow proper cleaning and maintenance guidelines.
6. Ship modification is encouraged, we will buy your ships back regardless of condition.
7. Have a safe and productive shift, whenever possible.
